defects.claim: H6FieldAccess must be fail-closed: only explicitly admitted fields are accessible
defects.old_evidence: H6FieldAccess({"unadmitted_metric": 7}).get("unadmitted_metric") returns 7; ["unadmitted_metric"] returns 7; .get with default also leaks
defects.root_cause: Implementation used permissive dict passthrough: __getitem__/get checked only FORBIDDEN_H6_FIELDS, not whitelist membership; missing field returned None/default instead of failing; iteration/membership/views leaked raw payload
defects.repair: Hardened H6FieldAccess to whitelist-closed: _ALLOWED_ALL_FIELDS gate on __getitem__/get/__contains__/__iter__/keys/values/items/__getattr__; unknown field raises H6ForbiddenFeatureAccess(field not admitted); allowed-but-missing returns standard missing behavior; iteration filtered to admitted fields only; add hash_validator guard
